_doc: Toy instance: 20 short Python function tasks graded by hidden unit tests, 10 more held out. A prototype of the loop, not a benchmark. S = pass rate over 20 x k trials. delta is null so `calibrate` estimates it from the base evaluation. The *_model fields apply on the vertex and anthropic backends; the openai backend uses RRSI_OPENAI_MODEL for every role.
